verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the documented scaffolding command `npm create cloudflare@latest my-app`, plus a claim that full-stack apps can be built with frameworks like React, Next and Astro. That implies starter-style project creation, but nothing in the pack describes a template catalog or one-click deploy. Missing for 10: an evidenced template/starter catalog for common use cases, a one-click deploy (e.g. deploy button or dashboard template deploy), documentation of what the create command scaffolds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
